language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.
language.lessonRating: How do you feel about this exercise?

dialog.text: Hi, I'm Chip.
Hello, my name is Grace. This is my school, but as you can see the roof of the school needs to be fixed and the walls need some paint.
To help the school get money we have an idea. Let's give a dance and music show for the people in the village.
Can you help me organize the show? I already asked all the students if they want to perform in the show. Grade 3, 4 and 5 already signed up.
I used a picture graph to show how many children from these groups are performing.
In grade 3 you see 3 people but if you look at the key, each person represents 4 children.
So in grade 3 we have 3 people x 4 children = 12 children from grade 3 who will perform.
Now look at grade 4. I see 2 people in the graph. The key says 1 person represents 4 children, so 2 people x 4 children = 8 children from grade 4 who will perform.
In grade 5 I see 4 people x 4 children = 16 children who will do a performance.
Now we have to get to work to make sure everything will be in order for the show!
